SELECT s.codigo, OS.COD_OS AS varCodPed, OS.DATA_TERMINO AS varData, s.descricao AS varNome, s.preco AS varValor, s.quantidade AS varQuant, s.subtotal AS varSubtotal, s.desconto AS varDesc, s.total AS varTotal, ISNULL(OS.COD_PEDIDO, 0) AS var_CodOS, s.cod_servico AS varCodServ FROM OS_Servicos_Auto s INNER JOIN OS ON s.cod_os = OS.COD_OS WHERE MONTH(OS.DATA_TERMINO) = 4 AND YEAR(OS.DATA_TERMINO) = 2026 ORDER BY s.data ;
